title: The Gravity of the Rust Belt
author: G. M. Lockridge
blurb: Ivo Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
